Normal Playwright click on [data-testid=analyze-AAPL-button] WITHOUT force=True now succeeds in <5s on both 1920-desktop and 390-mobile viewports. Follow-up dimming + refreshing-pill flow verified: refreshing-pill-AAPL appears on click, and the inner .min-w-0 wrapper computed opacity is 0.4 during analyzing state. One item was not re-verified: the geometric overflow of the parent grid cell was not eliminated — verdictRight (1082px desktop, 272px mobile) still extends past analyzeBtnLeft (1020px desktop, 221px mobile); overflow-hidden on the cell clips visual children but does NOT shrink the grid track itself, so the cell still occupies a wider physical slot than its col-span-2 nominal share. critical_code_review_comments: DashboardPage.jsx:81 — overflow-hidden on a CSS grid item does NOT constrain the grid track's own sizing. To actually stop a col-span-N cell from widening beyond its share when content is wider, you must either set 'minmax(0, 1fr)' on the grid-template-columns, or apply overflow:hidden+min-width:0 on a CHILD wrapper (not the grid item). The current visual clipping works but the track geometry is unchanged.

DashboardPage.jsx:90 — pointerEvents:'none' on the outer verdict-cell is the correct fix and resolves the click-intercept. Safe because the subtree contains no interactive children (SignalBadge is presentational, refreshing-pill also has pointer-events-none).

Residual design smell: on 1920px desktop the four action buttons in col-span-1 have only ~65px of horizontal room — expect future overflow bugs as icons or buttons are added. Consider promoting the action column to col-span-2 (and verdict to col-span-1) or switching to a flex layout with explicit min-widths.

rca of the issue: Iter 19 found that pointerEvents:none was on the wrong wrapper. Iter 20 applied the fix in the right place (outer div.relative at line 90) and additionally added overflow-hidden + min-w-0 to the parent grid cell. Both fixes are present and verified via getComputedStyle. The click interception is gone. The secondary geometric overflow (cell rect extending into sibling column) is NOT eliminated by overflow-hidden on the grid item — that CSS only affects how children are clipped for painting, not how the grid track itself sizes. The grid track sizes based on content unless minmax(0,1fr) is applied to the grid-template-columns. However, because pointer-events:none now covers the entire verdict-cell subtree, the geometric overflow is functionally harmless: Playwright hit-testing and real pointer events both pass through to the underlying analyze button.
